points.description: States that the * operator returns an alias/synonym (a reference or name) for the object that its operand points to in memory; equivalent wording such as 'the pointed-to object' or 'an lvalue for the object the pointer points to' earns the marks.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if the answer says it returns/gives the value stored at the pointer's address but does not convey that it is an alias/name for the pointed-to object.

levels.says: Says it returns or gives the value stored at the address held by the operand, without saying it is an alias/name for the pointed-to object.

points.description: Identifies * as the dereferencing operator, or says that it dereferences its operand/pointer.
points.partial_credit: Half credit for a vague pointer-related statement that does not name dereferencing or say the operator dereferences.

levels.says: Mentions pointers or indirection but does not identify * as the dereferencing operator or say that it dereferences.

rubric.notes: Full marks require both the alias/name-of-the-pointed-to-object idea and identifying * as the dereferencing operator. A response that only says it returns the value at the pointer earns partial credit on P1; a vague pointer reference earns partial credit on P2. Unrelated answers about pointer arithmetic or the address-of operator earn no marks.
